metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Tessa Wedgewise
records.biography_en: She recopies HyperNorm instructions until each has exactly one meaning; her reject pile is a second building.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The archive has developed structural ambitions.

records.name: Orrin Rollseal
records.biography_en: The Men in Black give him a seal for every forbidden exception.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His signature is also a very small rolling pin.

records.name: Basil Barleydue
records.biography_en: His building reduces every dissonant card to a ration discrepancy.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: A famine is apparently an arithmetic problem with poor manners.

records.name: Gil Copperclink
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory request shining certainty, so he polishes the same ingot through every historical era.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The copper is beginning to recognize the customer.

records.name: Enno Reedraft
records.biography_en: He packs the HyperNorm storehouse in sealed bundles so awkward questions cannot leak.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His manifest includes a separate entry for the river's attitude.

records.name: Luma Cupmeasure
records.biography_en: She notices that MiB officials receive larger cups and files the observation under foam.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Equality has been measured with the manager's cup.
